newsitem.title: CHINA: China state firms report net profit for Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: China state firms report net profit for Jan-May.

text.p: China's flagging state enterprises reported a net profit for the first five months of this year, recovering from a loss for all of 1996, officials said on Thursday.
China's state-owned firms made total profits of 46.69 billion yuan ($5.6 billion) in the first half while losses were 40.659 billion, an official of the State Statistical Bureau said.
That gave a net profit of 6.031 billion yuan, he said.
He declined to give a figure for the results for all state industry for 1996, but said the sector had reported a net loss for the year.
Economists have said the net loss for all of 1996 was unprecedented since the late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping launched his economic reforms in early 1979.
Figures available for the first quarter of last year showed a loss of three billion yuan -- the first reported net loss for state industry since the start of reform.
Chinese economists said state industry had struggled into the black after a strong performance in May reversed a net loss for the first four months.
